subject: general
question: Seven people with the initials of their names G, H, I, J. K, L and M were sipping their tea, sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. They were equidistant to one another. K was sitting to the immediate right of I. Only H was sitting between M and J. L was an immediate neighbour of M. G was sitting third to the right and fourth to the left of J. Who were the immediate neighbours of G?
solution:
**Given: **Seven people with the initials of their names G, H, I, J. K, L and M were sipping their tea, sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. They were equidistant to one another.

K was sitting to the immediate right of I.

G was sitting third to the right and fourth to the left of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2cbe10394f760960398721a92b2f47a7c89e7a60e3c20b82068f0fe737832edb.png] 

 

Only H was sitting between M and J.

L was an immediate neighbour of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a52d92b875c2483d99e8ae36b8f3e84e512f0c4dd10d0b272fec80f04ecfe58f.png] 

Therefore, the immediate neighbours of G are **K and L.**

Hence, the correct answer is **Option (4).**
